> Set sizes are in mm.  This should be documented in the specifications appendix of the book.

Yes, it is documented, but it didn't make sense to me because I
incorrectly assumed that object sizes resize as you resize the window;
but they don't, their sizes are absolute. Which of course immediately
makes me wonder how I can set them to be relative to the window size
or the plot limits or whatever.... But maybe I am just being
perverse.

-s
